Platinum Muriaticum Natronatum.



Chloroplatinate of Sodium. PtCl 4  2 NaCl.
        Solution.



Clinical. ─   Flatulence. Polyuria. Salivation.



Characteristics. ─   Hofer experimented with   Plat. m. n  . on the same man who took   Plat.
        mur  . The chief additional symptom was decided by increased secretion of urine and
        saliva.



SYMPTOMS.



2. Head. ─   Slight headache.



8. Mouth. ─   Decided increase in saliva.



11. Stomach. ─   Feeling of warmth and heaviness in
        stomach.  ─  Eructation of gas.  ─  Nausea and inclination
        to vomit.



12. Abdomen. ─   Rumbling in abdomen.  ─  Transient
        colic.



13. Stool. ─   Emission of flatus.



14. Urinary Organs. ─   Decidedly increased secretion
        of urine.
